hotspots.label: Myth: the SDK handles incremental for me.
hotspots.detail: The SDK does not persist checkpoints. Without an override of _get_last_crawl_timestamp(), since is None and the data client falls back to a full fetch.

hotspots.label: Myth: streaming connectors push identities.
hotspots.detail: Their indexing implementations do not run the optional get_identities() crawl.

hotspots.label: Myth: --max-items makes a live run safe.
hotspots.detail: max_items limits source consumption. It is not a Glean-side upload cap. On a full run, it makes the replacement partial, which can delete everything not included.

hotspots.label: Myth: smaller batches fix out-of-memory errors.
hotspots.detail: Batching happens after transform. Switch to a streaming connector.
